docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A two-dimensional world and its square narrator, a satire of Victorian society and an introduction to higher dimensions.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Edwin A. Abbott (1838–1926), Flatland, 1884 (second edition 1884). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
